name: Francesco Giannetta
bioAdditions: The FamilySearch tree gives Francesco Maria Giannetta's birth as 6 Mar 1812 in Bisaccia, his marriage to Lucia Macchia as 27 June 1836, and his death as 16 Feb 1848, aged 35, when his son Savino was six. That fits the 1867 marriage act's description of Savino as son of 'the late Francesco' (S1). The tree names his parents as Savino Giannetta (c.1786–1853) and Giuseppa Sena (1790–1822) (S2, S3). After Giuseppa's death, the elder Savino married in 1823 the widow Grazia Maria Gallicchio, Lucia Macchia's mother (S2, S4). If the tree is right, Francesco married his own stepsister. The tree also lists his children Savino (1838–1841) and Savino (1842).
funFacts: If the FamilySearch tree is right, Francesco married his stepsister: his widowed father Savino had married Lucia Macchia's widowed mother Grazia Maria Gallicchio in 1823, thirteen years before Francesco and Lucia wed.
